lessonMappingReview: Real catalog lessons C5-L01 harmonic oscillation, C5-L02 propagation, C5-L03 signed superposition, C5-L04 intensity and C5-L05 acoustic levels and frequency-dependent perception were read. Course C5, individual skills and prerequisite lists and C6 reuse were checked against the actual candidate edition.
limitations: Only assigned ideal models are verified; intensity addition requires the stated receiver or propagation convention, coherent phase relations can drift, real waves may leave the linear regime, and equal intensity does not imply identical subjective perception.
Literal signatures bind exactly the prose read; arbitrary future prose is not semantically parsed.
Exact alternatives use a bounded rational, decimal, pi or integer-radical monomial grammar and the reviewed unit suffix. Arbitrary expressions and functions are rejected.

Rebound keys, units, sources, equivalent choices and figure scales are rejected after test-only replacement of tokens and edition hashes. The plausible false prose case is rejected by frozen reading, not a general natural-language proof checker.
AI_CONCEPTUAL remains distinct from EXACT_ORACLE. Human approval is NOT_RUN; all drafts remain DRAFT.

primaryBeforeKeys: Apply a dimensionless positive intensity ratio inside the logarithm, derive inverses by exponentiation, and calibrate the numerical level coefficient rather than treating logarithmic units as a linear physical intensity. The zero-level boundary and perception task have separate hypotheses.

propertyAudit.coverage: Period-averaged amplitude-square intensity, varying-frequency exception, exact logarithmic inverse and zero-level boundary, incoherent mean cross-term removal and phase-preserving coherent amplitude sum. Separate phase flip, nonlinear versus linear means, affine displays, strict positive domains and continuous scale freedom. Fresh and saved reading identity against actual package and bindings.

records.distractors: 100 is the pure intensity ratio, 2 its logarithm before multiplication by ten and 30 ignores division by the reference. The logarithm must not retain units in its argument.
records.manualArithmetic: In the delivered pW/m² parametrization, intensity ratio 1000/10 is exactly 100=10². The numerical level coefficient is 20 and the level label is 20 dB; the common power unit cancels.
records.physicalAssumptions: Positive physical intensity and explicitly assigned positive reference expressed in the same unit; the logarithm acts on their dimensionless ratio. The common branch is I>Iᵣ, while standalone08 explicitly admits equality. Numerical fixtures are openly reparameterized in pW/m² and exact powers of ten, with symbols and targets retained. Displays are affine in the numerical level coefficient, not in intensity. Perception03 is separately conceptual and does not assert a clinical result.
